status: v1 elevation proposal; hierarchy and emphasis are carried by floating surfaces and diffuse shadows, never by outlines or saturated fills

z0.use: window base; chrome and navigation sit directly on it

z1.use: titlebar and sidebar; flat against the base

z2.use: main file surface; floats above the chrome

z3.use: menus, task panel, selection card, hovered/selected rows

z4.use: modals and dialogs only; never for persistent chrome

motion.selected: 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); preserve geometry, raise z and shadow
motion.reduced_motion: no lift animation; final elevation state only

limits.no_outline: borders are not used to communicate hierarchy, focus, selection or hover
limits.no_color_emphasis: saturated colors are reserved for brand, focus accessibility, progress and links; selection/hierarchy stay neutral
limits.dark_mode: shadow is paired with surface luminance steps; shadow alone is not treated as sufficient in dark mode
